# SF Symbols converted assets — local frontend preview

Historical provenance only. As of formal-package development 0.1.25, the Android `sf_*.xml` resources have been replaced by fixed Microsoft Fluent SVG paths under MIT; their resource IDs remain for compatibility. See `../fluent-system-icons/NOTICE.md`. This document records the earlier local preview source and grants no redistribution rights to those earlier assets.

Source repository: https://github.com/UsePreside/sf-symbols
Baseline commit: 9c12b2ea060e397ac6c554338599ae13d8578666
Data version: SF Symbols 4.0; available downloaded weight: bold.
Downloaded via Fastly jsDelivr CDN; data Git blob verified against GitHub f334065489ab590808027d71907b4daea000f0f3.

This is a third-party conversion project, not an Apple-owned repository. The upstream README states that the maintainer does not own or claim ownership of SF Symbols. No new asset redistribution license was found in that repository or package.json. Underlying Apple terms are not replaced by this conversion.

These selected symbols are used in the user-requested local Android frontend preview. This notice is provenance, not a license grant. Formal redistribution requires separate confirmation of applicable authorization. We did not claim MIT, Apache, or open licensing for these converted SF Symbols.

Original SVG paths are preserved; only viewport centering and format conversion to Android VectorDrawable were performed. Per-resource symbol names and data hashes are recorded in provenance.json. The complete source dataset/fonts are not bundled.
